forward a positive recommendation to the City Council on the Ordinance Amendment to Section 13.76.700-Land Excavation Special Requirements for Grading and Retaining within Required Setbacks with the following changes: City of Holladay Planning Commission Meeting - 06/16/2020 4 1. Line 67 - (1) A minimum of an eight-foot setback shall be required for any retaining wall system. 2. Line 68 - (2) Each subsequent retaining wall must be accompanied by an additional, horizontal landscaped offset of eight feet (8’). 3. Line 71 - (3) The maximum height of any retaining wall shall not exceed four feet (4’) measured from the natural grade. Height shall be stepped every ten feet (10’) to accommodate changes in the natural topography. 4. Line 73 - (4) If a guard rail is used in conjunction with the retaining wall, it cannot exceed 42 inches in height. The motion was
